authorities.name: Ministry of Religious Affairs and Endowments
authorities.evidence: official ministry history states responsibility for religious guidance, fatwa, Quranic education and authentic Islamic culture; ministry also states responsibility for organizing and modernizing fatwa activity.

authorities.name: UAE Council for Fatwa
authorities.evidence: Federal Law of 2024 specifies the Council's composition and competencies, including issuing public, contemporary and proactive fatwas and reviewing fatwa content from official entities.

authorities.name: Majelis Ulama Indonesia (MUI)
authorities.evidence: official MUI site provides a Fatwa collection and identifies MUI Fatwa and DSN MUI channels; fatwa index is maintained on the official domain.

authorities.name: International Islamic Fiqh Academy (IIFA)
authorities.evidence: international fiqh academy registry entry; classify as international scholarly body, not a state fatwa authority.

classificationRules.officialStatus: Only establish official/institutional status from the authority's own official domain or governing legal instrument.
classificationRules.attribution: Every fatwa remains attributed to its issuing body or named scholar; institutional status does not make a statement infallible.
classificationRules.conflictHandling: Preserve attributable differences rather than silently merging divergent rulings.

ingestion: catalog-first; verify authority, provenance, rights, canonical URL, author/body, date and document identity before corpus ingestion.
